user.description: Set up the IOWAP integration. Requires the IOWAP app (same repository) to be installed and configured with your relay URL.
user.title: IOWAP

init.title: IOWAP domain exposure
init.description: Choose what IOWAP agents may do per domain. {note}

submit_task.name: Submit task
submit_task.description: Submits a single-stage task to the IOWAP relay via the IOWAP app. Use a capability the relay knows, e.g. `agent.ai` on one of your nodes.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: JSON payload for the capability stage.

get_capabilities.name: Get cluster capabilities
get_capabilities.description: Returns the capabilities the IOWAP cluster currently offers (incl. input_schema), read from the server metrics entity. For scripting/automations via response_variable.

include_schema.name: Include input schema
include_schema.description: Include each capability's input_schema in the response.

available_only.name: Available only
available_only.description: Only return capabilities that currently have an available node.
